# Psalm 69 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the music director. To the tune of 'Lilies.' A psalm of David.

**2** Save me, O God, for the floodwaters are up to my neck.

**3** Deeper and deeper I sink into the mire; I can't find a foothold. I am in deep water, and the floods overwhelm me.

**4** I am exhausted from crying for help; my throat is parched. My eyes are swollen with weeping, waiting for my God to help me.

**5** Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs on my head. Many enemies try to destroy me with lies, demanding that I give back what I didn't steal.

**6** O God, You know how foolish I am; my sins cannot be hidden from You.

**7** Don't let those who trust in You be disgraced because of me, O Sovereign LORD of Heaven's Armies. Don't let me cause them to be humiliated, O God of Israel.

**8** For I endure insults for Your sake; humiliation is written all over my face.

**9** Even my own brothers pretend they don't know me; they treat me like a stranger.

**10** Passion for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.

**11** When I weep and fast, they scoff at me.

**12** When I dress in burlap to show sorrow, they make fun of me.

**13** I am the favorite topic of town gossip, and all the drunks sing about me.

**14** But I keep praying to You, LORD, hoping this time You will show me favor. In Your unfailing love, O God, answer my prayer with Your sure salvation.

**15** Rescue me from the mud; don't let me sink any deeper! Save me from those who hate me, and pull me from these deep waters.

**16** Don't let the floods overwhelm me, or the deep waters swallow me, or the pit of death devour me.

**17** Answer my prayers, O LORD, for Your unfailing love is wonderful. Take care of me, for Your mercy is so plentiful.

**18** Don't hide from Your servant; answer me quickly, for I am in deep trouble!

**19** Come and redeem me; free me from my enemies.

**20** You know of my shame, scorn, and disgrace. You see all that my enemies are doing.

**21** Their insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. If only one person would show some pity; if only one would turn and comfort me.

**22** But instead, they give me poison for food; they offer me sour wine for my thirst.

**23** Let the bountiful table set before them become a snare and their prosperity become a trap.

**24** Let their eyes go blind so they cannot see, and make their bodies shake continually.

**25** Pour out Your fury on them; consume them with Your burning anger.

**26** Let their homes become desolate and their tents be deserted.

**27** To the one You have punished, they add insult to injury; they add to the pain of those You have hurt.

**28** Pile their sins up high, and don't let them go free.

**29** Erase their names from the Book of Life; don't let them be counted among the righteous.

**30** I am suffering and in pain. Rescue me, O God, by Your saving power.

**31** Then I will praise God's name with singing, and I will honor Him with thanksgiving.

**32** For this will please the LORD more than sacrificing cattle, more than presenting a bull with its horns and hooves.

**33** The humble will see their God at work and be glad. Let all who seek God's help be encouraged.

**34** For the LORD hears the cries of the needy; He does not despise His imprisoned people.

**35** Praise Him, O heaven and earth, the seas and all that move in them.

**36** For God will save Jerusalem and rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there and settle in their own land.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **69:1-4**: The drowning imagery is among the most vivid in the Psalms: rising waters, sinking mire, no foothold. This isn't metaphor for the psalmist — it FEELS like drowning.

— PNEUMA
